items.source: Base class for WebSocketHandlerRegistrations that gathers all the configuration options but allows subclasses to put together the actual HTTP request mappings.
items.translation: `WebSocketHandlerRegistrations` 接口的基类，用于收集所有配置选项，但允许子类构建实际的 HTTP 请求映射。

items.source: Alternative to WebSocketHandlerRegistration.setAllowedOrigins(String...) that supports more flexible patterns for specifying the origins for which cross-origin requests are allowed from a browser.
items.translation: 替代WebSocketHandlerRegistration.setAllowedOrigins(String...)，支持更灵活的指定浏览器允许跨域请求的源的模式。
`WebSocketHandlerRegistration` 接口在 `org.springframework.web.socket.config.annotation` 包中的用法。

items.source: A helper class for configuring WebSocketHandler request handling including SockJS fallback options.
items.translation: 用于配置 `WebSocketHandler` 请求处理的辅助类，包括 SockJS 回退选项。

items.source: Support for annotation-based WebSocket setup in configuration classes.
items.translation: 支持在配置类中使用基于注解的 WebSocket 设置。

items.source:
Add more handlers that will share the same configuration (interceptors, SockJS
config, etc).
items.translation: 添加更多将共享相同配置（拦截器、SockJS 配置等）的处理器。

items.source: Configure a WebSocketHandler at the specified URL paths.
items.translation: 在指定的 URL 路径处配置 WebSocketHandler。

items.source: Configure interceptors for the handshake request.
items.translation: 配置握手请求的拦截器。

items.source: Set the origins for which cross-origin requests are allowed from a browser.
items.translation: 设置允许浏览器发起跨域请求的源。
